title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
For each n >= 1, let X_{n,1},...,X_{n,n} be real random variables.
For every fixed positive integer j, assume X_{n,j} -> 0 in probability along n >= j.
Then max_{1<=j<=n}|X_{n,j}| -> 0 in probability.
Proof. Fix epsilon > 0.
The union bound gives P(max_{j<=n}|X_{n,j}| > epsilon) <= sum_{j=1}^n P(|X_{n,j}| > epsilon).
Each summand tends to zero for fixed j, so the displayed sum tends to zero, proving the claim.
